Language learning for Mac

Catch a phrase. Make it yours.

Learn with the videos, podcasts, and texts you already enjoy. Follow along with subtitles, save what you want to remember, and come back to it with flashcards.

Explore the features ↓ Getting started ↗

macOS 15.6 or later

Feature categories

Player & subtitles Shadowing Markdown notes PDF reader Built-in browser Flashcards AI & language practice

Player & subtitles

Slow down a line, hear how it fits together, and keep the phrases you want to use.

Looping and pacing Four playback views Sense groups and lookup Generate and translate Subtitle display and notes Media and tracks

Looping and pacing

Loop one sentence, several selected sentences, or an A–B time range. Set repetitions per lesson and pauses between sentences. Playlists can repeat one item, repeat all, or shuffle.

Four playback views

Use the default view, hide subtitles, hide the video, or switch to mini controls.

Sense groups and lookup

Split long subtitles into sense groups and highlight them as you listen. Look up words directly in the subtitle text.

Generate and translate

Generate subtitles with on-device speech models or Apple speech recognition on macOS 26. Translate with Apple Translation or a service you connect. Search for subtitles online or export the subtitle text.

Subtitle display and notes

Adjust text size, show or hide the translation, swap the order of both languages, and toggle timecodes. Highlight a line, apply bold, italics, underline or strikethrough, and add a note.

Media and tracks

Play local video or audio, add external audio tracks, and display styled ASS/SSA subtitles. MKV and WebM can be converted on your Mac for playback.

Shadowing

Record your own voice, listen back against the original, and find what to practice next.

Record and compare Practice grid Highlights across views Merged shadowing and read-aloud Scores, grades and AI feedback

Record and compare

Record one subtitle at a time and compare it with the original. Choose a waveform style and click anywhere on the original or recorded waveform to start playback there.

Practice grid

Hover over a grid cell to preview the subtitle. Enable double-click to play that line in the player and press and hold a cell to mark it.

Highlights across views

Sync highlighted cells with the player’s subtitle list. Highlighted lines also appear among the key sentences in the video note.

Merged shadowing and read-aloud

Combine selected lines or all subtitles for one continuous shadowing recording. In AI feedback read-aloud mode, click a sentence to hear the feedback from that point.

Scores, grades and AI feedback

Connect a speech service for pronunciation scores and grades, including accuracy and fluency. With a configured AI service, get feedback on a line or an overall assessment.

Markdown notes

Keep expressions, context, and video timecodes together in Markdown files you can take with you.

Local files Rich blocks and media Links and organization Media notes

Local files

Notes are stored as plain .md files in a folder you choose, so you can open them with other Markdown editors.

Rich blocks and media

Write headings, task lists, tables, formulas, diagrams, and callouts. Embed images, audio, video, and bookmarks in a note.

Links and organization

Link to a note or a specific block, view backlinks, and reuse content with synced blocks. Navigate by folders, tags, and the outline.

Media notes

Collect the subtitle lines you mark in a video note. Click a saved timecode to return to the corresponding point in the player.

PDF reader

Read, mark up, and translate documents as you go. Turn a useful passage into a card while it’s fresh.

Find your place Annotate and draw OCR and translation Flashcards from PDFs

Find your place

Navigate via page thumbnails, outlines, and bookmarks. Search the document, and use the annotation sidebar to return to your marks.

Annotate and draw

Highlight or underline text, add comments, and mark up pages with shapes or freehand drawing.

OCR and translation

Recognize text in scanned pages with OCR. Translate selections or use comparison mode to read a translation alongside the source.

Flashcards from PDFs

Create flashcards from selected PDF text or page regions while you read.

Built-in browser

Read articles in the same workspace, with the original text and translation side by side in your workflow.

Tabs and bookmarks Reader mode and ad blocking Page and selection translation

Tabs and bookmarks

Open sites in workspace tabs and group related tabs. Save bookmarks in folders and open a folder as a tab group.

Reader mode and ad blocking

Use reader mode for a cleaner view of articles and enable ad blocking while browsing.

Page and selection translation

Translate a page with the original text in view, or translate just the text you select.

Flashcards

Bring useful expressions back before you forget them, with cards drawn from the things you study.

Card types Spaced repetition Organization and progress Anki exchange

Card types

Create cards from notes and saved phrases, including front-and-back cards, fill-in-the-blank cards, table cards, and image occlusion.

Spaced repetition

FSRS-7 schedules practice based on your ratings. Review due cards and check each card’s practice history.

Organization and progress

Browse cards by note or tag, set a daily goal, and see activity and streaks in desktop widgets.

Anki exchange

Import and export Anki packages and supported text formats.

AI & language practice

Ask about a passage, check your grammar, or practice speaking with a service you connect.

Chat with learning material Grammar and speaking

Chat with learning material

Connect your own AI service to ask questions about your notes and PDFs.

Grammar and speaking

Check grammar, dictate, practice in AI voice conversations, and listen to text read aloud. Cloud features use the service you set up.

Keep studying offline.

Play local media, record shadowing practice, read PDFs, edit notes, and review flashcards without an internet connection. Download speech models and Apple Translation languages to generate and translate subtitles offline.

Your notes are plain Markdown files in a folder you choose. Cloud translation and AI services are optional and use your own API keys.
